subject: cache option in scripts for knitr::spin()

messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: cache option in scripts for knitr::spin()
parts:
As I mentioned in a previous message, In some scripts I have chunks that I do not want to be processed every time I run spin("myscript.R"),
According to the answers to that message, in those few (i.e. 3) chunks I should set:

#+ chunkX, cache=TRUE
a <- Rfunction_that_takesalongtime()

Assume that, after a while, I might want those chunks to actually be re-processed.
Then, I would need to edit each chunk and switch to
#+ chunkX, cache=FALSE
a <- Rfunction_that_takesalongtime()

Is there an alternative, so that I do not have to edit?
For example, is there an option within spin() that would process all chunks ignoring the cache=TRUE?
or, could the chunk option be written with a variable:
#+ chunkX, cache=cacheoption
a <- Rfunction_that_takesalongtime()

and then just assign cacheoption=TRUE or cacheoption=FALSE at the
begining of the script?
Or perhaps I can just convert to  myscript.md and there is a way to achieve this
using markdownToHTML()?
(I'm actually a bit confused on when the R code is actually executed)

Thanks

Agus

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] cache option in scripts for knitr::spin()
parts:
You have answered your own question: cache=cacheoption will work. You
just need to tweak cacheoption to TRUE or FALSE.

Regards,
Yihui
